test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

Throw the jacket.

options.text: The jacket was thrown by you.
The jacket must thrown by you.

solution:
The correct answer is: ***Let the jacket be thrown. ***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Given sentence: Throw the jacket
 
• It is an **imperative sentence(Do verb+Object)**
 
• So for converting this type of sentence we have to use the rule 
 
• **Let +object +be+Third from of main verb.**
 
• Here **Throw** is the **main verb **and **the jacket** is the** object.**

Hence the passive voice will be: ***Let the jacket be thrown. ***So the correct ***option is (3).***
